{{Quote|The bigger the galaxy, the sweeter the homecoming.|Corellian proverb|<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>}}
'''Corellia''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], which included [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was also the birthplace of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as well as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and New Republic hero [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], along with many other humans who played important roles in the histories of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], New Republic and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

Collectively, the planets of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] were known as the [[Five Brothers/Legends|Five Brothers]]. As the largest planet and the closest to [[Corell/Legends|Corell]], Corellia was often called the "Eldest Brother" or the "Eldest." Historians believed the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] assembled the system artificially, the worlds brought from other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for unknown reasons. Some believed that these Celestials populated Corellia with [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The most important planet in the Corellian star system in the Corellian Sector is Corellia, and the capital city is Coronet.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Corelliascape_TFU.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Snow-covered mountains on Corellia]]
Corellia was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Corell/Legends|Corell]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], which was itself part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Considered to be one of the inner worlds of the Core,<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref> Corellia was also located at the intersection of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. Corellia was one of the [[Five Brothers/Legends|Five Brothers]], a collective term for the five terrestrial planets in the Corellian system.<ref name="CATCW" /> Corellia, known as the "Elder Brother," served as the administrative center for its entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|corellia|Corellia}}</ref> Its [[Standard day/Legends|day]] lasted 25 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], while its [[Standard year/Legends|year]] consisted of 329 standard days.<ref name="TEA" />

A terrestrial world with a diameter of 11,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]],<ref name="TEA" /> Corellia possessed a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], a temperate climate, standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]],<ref name="CATCW" /> and a moderate hydrosphere. Corellian weather was characterized by warm, sunny days separated by long, severe rainstorms. Like every other planet in the Corellian system, Corellia had a [[planetary repulsor]].<ref name="CTD" /> The surface of Corellia contained rolling hills, dense forests, lush fields, vast seas,<ref name="CATCW" /> beaches, mountain peaks, and [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] swamps,<ref name="TEA" /> as well as an eastern ocean and a western ocean. Corellia also featured urban terrain,<ref name="CTD" /> was designated as an industrial world,<ref name="CATCW" /> and was considered a highly developed planet.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

[[File:CorelliaLand.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A rural community on Corellia]]
Three large continents were present on Corellia; the planet's capital of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] was located on the coast of the southernmost<ref name="CATCW" /> and primary continent, near the eastern ocean. Outside of such [[City/Legends|cities]], the landscape hosted small towns and [[Farm/Legends|farms]].<ref name="CTD" /> Corellia was an exporter of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]], agricultural goods imported luxury items, raw materials, and weapons. Its [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction facilities had been moved into [[Realspace/Legends|space]], leaving its surface largely rural.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] were located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Corellia, and facilities fitted with [[Warship/Legends|warship]] docks were on the planet.<ref name="CATCW" />

Corellian lifeforms included the [[Corellian grass snake]] and the [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panther]]. The primary law enforcement agency on Corellia was the [[Corellian Security Force]], also known as CorSec,<ref name="CATCW" /> a branch of the planetary government<ref name="HG">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref> that resembled a police force.<ref name="CATCW" /> The jurisdiction of CorSec included the entirety of Corellia and while each city on Corellia was allowed its own police and detective agencies, CorSec acted in all cities, towns, and rural regions, acting as a coordinating force in investigations involving multiple cities or regions.<ref name="HG" />

Snow-covered mountains dominated part of the landscape. It was rumored to have many deep underwater caverns with orange [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crystals. The largest cities were Coronet, the tourist haven of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]], the double-city Tyrena and the mountain hamlets of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] and [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]]. Immigrants from the neighboring planet of [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] constructed an elaborate network of tunnels beneath the planet's surface. These [[Selonian Tunnels]] were used by people of all races as a kind of subterranean metropolis.

[[File:Corelliantrain.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Corellia had a number of mag-lev train systems as a means of transportation for citizens and cargo.]]
The Corellians were known for their prowess with starships. From building ships to flying them, Corellians were well known for their skills. Because [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] were well-known occupations of a strong number of Corellians, the local navy had been specializing in techniques designed to combat economic loss due to their activities. Because of this need, the navy was well-developed and modernized. The [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] and the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian Gunship]] were two examples, as well as the powerful [[Corellian Dreadnaught]].

Of interest is the fact that Corellia's navy remained autonomous from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] throughout the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], maintaining its own independence and individual naval traditions until it was dissolved following the original Centerpoint crisis. From this point until partway through the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Corellia lacked any autonomous military forces, relying solely on the sector fleet provided by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
===Pre-Republic===
{{Quote|If the Five Brothers were put in their current orbits on purpose, it must have happened in the dimmest mists of time, even before the dawn of the Old Republic, more than a thousand generations ago.|Han Solo|<ref name="AaC" />}}
[[File:JKAlevelshot_t1_rail.png|thumb|right|Location of Corellia in the galaxy]]
Corellia may have been placed in its orbital position in the Corellian system by the ancient device known as [[Centerpoint Station]]. The world's population of Humans, Drall and Selonians predated its recorded history.<ref name="CATCW" /> Corellia eventually became a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] world of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. In circa [[30,000 BBY]], Corellian slaves helped build the [[Star Forge]]. When the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] fell victim to a plague, the Corellians freed themselves in a revolt that occurred around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Corellian explorers early in their history scaled the [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] mesa.

Corellians spent the next 200 years reverse-engineering the [[Force-drive|Rakatan hyperdrive]] without [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] tools of the Rakata. A midstep, [[hyperspace cannon]]s, connected Corellia with other [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. The reinvention of the hyperdrive in circa [[25,053 BBY]] let the afore-mentioned and other worlds become the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

===Galactic Republic===
{{Quote|Corellia revolutionized the shipbuilding industry, pioneered hyperspace travel, founded the Republic. You will not ruin everything we've built.|Bedoch|<ref name="TOR:MH">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Making History|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The Corellian Engineering Corporation was founded by a consortium of Corellia's finest designers and shipbuilders<ref name="G2">{{GamerCite|2|A Legacy of Starships}}</ref> early on, perhaps before the dawn of the Republic. While rumors of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] dawn on Corellia were false, as the Jedi were originally from [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Corellian Jedi]] did keep a distinct set of traditions that set them apart from other Jedi, including green robes and [[Jedi Credit]]s.

Corellia was a political power by the time of the Galactic Republic's formation, and the foundation of the Corellian Run in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] ensured its economic dominance within the emerging Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> of which it was a member in good standing.<ref name="CATCW" /> As Corellia prospered, it expanded its influence into neighboring space, acquiring and colonizing several dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] which collectively became known as the Corellian sector. Over millennia, the world gained a reputation as a source of excellent ships and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and a refuge for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="CATCW" />

Along with Coruscant, Corellia enjoyed the greatest benefits from transactions occurring along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the Corellian Run and scouts from Corellia established the Corellian Trade Spine around [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Corellia StarDrive]] splintered off CEC in c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], but was bought out by CEC in c. [[3000 BBY]]. CEC was one of the larger shipbuilding firms in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and its [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] were one of the most extensive in the galaxy. Examples of Corellian ships included the CR90 Corellian Corvette, the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] freighter and the DP-20 Corellian Gunship.

[[File:CorelliaFlag.png|thumb|left|150px|Flag of Corellia]]
Corellians were among the first and foremost hyperspace explorers. The Corellians discovered [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]] in [[10,000 BBY]], [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] in [[8000 BBY]] and [[Koboth]] prior to [[219 BBY]]. They colonized [[Rabaan]] in the [[Subterra Period]], [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] ([[3000 BBY]]), [[Trulalis]], and [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]]. Corellia was an early trading partner of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] when [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] entered the Republic (c. [[3956 BBY]]). In the [[Mandalorian Wars]], it was the site of important [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] drydocks.

Almost [[10,000 BBY]], a spartan sect established a monastery on Kor Vella. During a boom in CEC's popularity, miners discovered ore deposits near the mesa, transforming the Kor Vella community into a luxurious center of tourism and wealth.<ref name="SWG" />

[[File:Corellia_TOR_new.png|thumb|right|250px|Corellia during the Cold War]]
In [[3640 BBY]] Corellia was [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Following a period of large-scale conflict the Republic successfully liberated the planet.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Corellia}}</ref>

During the [[third Galactic War]] in [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TOR updates|6.0}}</ref> [[Darth Malgus]] launched a large-scale invasion on Corellia in an attempt to destroy the newly constructed Republic shipyard known as the [[Meridian Complex]].

Corellia allied with [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] and [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] circa [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]] in a failed attempt to conquer the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]]. [[470 BBY|30 years later]], Corellia attempted to secede from the Republic; although progressing far enough to close its sector's borders and withdraw from the Senate using ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', the plan ultimately failed and the system continued as a begrudging Republic member-state.

The elitist [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Nomad's Retreat]] in the [[Nomad Mountains]] expanded its membership to become a public resort in [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]]. Over the next few centuries, a village grew around the retreat, known as [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] and eventually merged with the Retreat, becoming a resort town.<ref name="SWG" /> A few decades later in [[380 BBY/Legends|380 BBY]], a Corellian [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Keiran Halcyon]] defeated the [[Afarathu]] pirates, a sect of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] terrorists, whom were trying to kill all Humans on Corellia.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> The Afarathu were not gone forever and would plague Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG" />

Although it has most often been regarded as a monarchy due to the presence of royal rulers of some kind, these leaders' direct hand in affairs of state has varied wildly throughout history. At various points, Corellia has been everything from an anarchic kleptocracy to a parliamentary democracy.<ref name="TORC" /> [[King/Legends|King]] [[Berethron e Solo]] established a democratic government in [[312 BBY]], replacing his own [[Corellian empire|absolute monarchy]]. Corellia was home to several multi-stellar corporate conglomerates, including [[Gowix Computers]] (founded in [[219 BBY]]), the [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] and of course, CEC. Many of these competed directly with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] for galactic influence. Over time these companies became very powerful and in [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]] overthrew the historic parliamentary constitutional monarchy founded by the Royal [[Solo family/Legends|House of Solo]] in favor of a government more amenable to unrestricted commerce. This new business-supported regime was called the [[Diktat]].

Between [[46 BBY/Legends|46]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Krai H'voc]] settled on Corellia, where she fell in love with and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a Human. After giving birth to [[Bey]], the first known Human-Nagai [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]], H'voc reluctantly obeyed orders from her Nagai superiors to end her relationship and continue her mission elsewhere.<ref name="TFW">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Corellia was represented directly in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Com Fordox]], who in the next year helped elect [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="cloakofdeception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] personally defended Corellia during the crisis with [[Ashaar Khorda]]. The planet's name was pronounced '''K'rell''' by [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], but it is unknown if this is the actual name of the planet in [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] or if this was on account of Mitth'raw'nuruodo's unfamiliarity with [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], or indeed if he even knew of the existence of Corellia prior to his first contact with Humans.

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|If Operation Durge's Lance continues to push Coreward, Corellia will be the next world targeted.|A [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] report during the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]]|<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition">{{InsiderCite|74|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:2:29 Edition}}</ref>}}
[[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] became the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of Corellia in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]]<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and represented the world during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="HNN1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_1.html|Palpatine Sets Army Vote Date}}</ref> After a week of secret meetings with [[Diktat]] [[Shyla Merricope]], Bel Iblis announced on 13:3:13 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]] that Corellia would close its borders and abstain from the upcoming vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], invoking ''[[Contemplanys Hermi]]'', an obscure clause in the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] that allowed Corellia to unilaterally withdraw from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for the duration of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|news/13314_1.html|Corellia Closes Borders}}</ref> The closure of Corellia's borders was carried out on 13:3:14.<ref name="HNN3">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|jediwatch/1352_2.html|Corellian Jedi Return}}</ref>

Bel Iblis's attempt to insulate the system failed and Corellia was soon embroiled in the subsequent turmoil of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]];<ref name="DB" /> the world supported the Republic war effort and dispatched task forces from its sector fleet to repel [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] advances and aid the Jedi.<ref name="EGW" /> Though the planet was spared an invasion or aggressive military action, presumably the intense fighting on nearby [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] weakened its already troubled economy. The Corellian sector was heavily fortified, but the CIS fleet bypassed it through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

At some point during the Clone Wars, a Separatist unit successfully infiltrated the planet Corellia. In a remote region of the planet, they managed to secretly build an underground automated [[Corellia Droid Factory|droid factory]] in preparation for a possible invasion of Corellia. The objective was to produce and deploy large amounts of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to cause chaos on the ground while the bulk of Separatist forces engaged the planetary defenses from space. However, the CIS bypassed Corellia when they invaded the Core Worlds and struck directly at Coruscant. The invasion of Corellia never happened and the factory was never activated.<ref name="SWG:TtLV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Lieutenant Varias in the Corsec camp|Corellia}}</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
[[File:CorelliaFalcon_btm.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' departs Corellia]]
{{Quote|The Emperor's Corellian government got scared. Not just scared of the Rebellion, but scared of everyone. They decided the safest thing to do was not to trust anyone at all. They decided they didn't want the traders. In fact, they didn't want any outsiders.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="AaC" />}}
With the declaration of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Diktat [[Dupas Thomree]] made a deal with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]: Thomree could govern the Corellian Sector as he wished and mostly free of Imperial mandates so long as he paid taxes, war matériel and homage to the Emperor. Immediately after the start of the New Order, Corellia was wracked by anti-Imperial protests.

The Republic's planetary Governor of Corellia, [[Fliry Vorru]], became the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. The Moff tended to turn a blind eye to crime, being more interested in greater power and was considered a rival of Palpatine. In [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]], Vorru was sent to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] after being framed by Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. This allowed Xizor to set up his [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] lieutenant [[Zekka Thyne]] as a criminal kingpin on Corellia.

The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Groola]] arrived on Corellia in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] and reopened a bar, which was renamed [[Groola's Place]] and transformed into an underground complex.<ref name="CATCW" /> Diktat Dupas Thomree died in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. He was replaced by [[Daclif Gallamby]], who was little more than a puppet of the Imperial Governor. At this time, [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] went underground and began plotting secession.

Garm Bel Iblis's concerns that the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] was causing Corellia to lose its distinctive identity motivated him to participate in [[Cantham House Meetings|discussions]] regarding organized resistance to the Empire.<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> As Corellians were drafted into military service for the Empire to deal with the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], the overall security of the sector decreased. [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] took advantage of the opportunity that presented itself and grew more brazen, launching many raids upon starships that used nearby trade routes.

====Galactic Civil War====
{{Quote|The sector's government stayed more and more to themselves. They didn't trust anyone else. The government started making up all sorts of rules to keep more and more things hidden and private. It got harder and harder to get the most ordinary sort of information, harder and harder for outsiders to send messages or visit any of the Corellian planets. And the Corellian leaders stopped trusting their own people, and put more and more of the same sort of restrictions on them. And with the Imperial government propping up the Corellian Diktat-that's what they called their chief of state-the Diktat could do whatever he wanted without any fear of the people protesting.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="AaC" />}}
Following the abandonment of [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established a [[Hidden Rebel Base|base]] on Corellia in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] before moving on to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SWG" /> That same year, investors on Corellia found their shares in [[Bansche Tech/Legends|Bansche Tech]] and [[SGI Systems, Inc.]] worthless after [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] announced the nationalization of the companies in 36:4,<ref name="GNN6">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> and [[Gowix Computers]] later transferred its corporate charter from Corellia to [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].<ref name="GNN7">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> By 1 ABY, Corellia was one of the few Core Worlds that allowed aliens to work in strategic manufacturing jobs.<ref name="J8">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

The defecting General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] was [[Battle of Corellia (1 ABY)|rescued]] from an Imperial ambush in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. [[2 ABY/Legends|One year later]], Zekka Thyne was [[Capture of Zekka Thyne|captured]] on Corellia by Colonel [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. During this action, Thrawn placed a tracking device on a freighter that led the Empire to the Rebellion at [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]].<ref name="SideTrip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>

====The fall of the Empire====
{{Quote|Once there was no more Empire to provide outside support, people started to be less and less afraid. They started doing what they wanted, instead of what the rules said they should do. The more people got away with breaking the rules, the braver they got, and the more rules they broke. The security forces didn't feel brave enough to stop it all-and they didn't want to go on shooting their own people. It all just sort of collapsed. The Diktat was still there in his palace giving out orders and demanding that people be executed, but no one listened anymore, and no one obeyed his orders.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="AaC" />}}
Although Corellia was a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the Galactic Empire in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> delegates from Corellia were among the main signatories of the [[Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets]]<ref name="TFW" /> and Corellia was one of the founding member worlds of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="RESB">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> A week after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in 4 ABY, Alliance pilots from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], as well as [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], were ambushed by Imperial forces on Corellia. A large number of Imperials streamed into the planet following the death of Palpatine, giving new power to pro-Imperial factions on the world. A large Imperial fleet was soon sent by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] to defend the world and its shipyards, including forces from [[Ord Mirit]].

[[File:CoronetCity-XWRS26.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Coronet City, capital of Corellia in 4 ABY]]
Six months after Endor, this fleet was one of the most powerful concentrations of Imperial might anywhere in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], consisting of twenty-five [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] under Admiral [[Jaeffis]]—by comparison, Kuat had just fifteen Star Destroyers and Corellia's defenses were scheduled to be even more heavily reinforced when Admiral [[Roek]] arrived to assume overall command, with the Super Star Destroyer [[Aggressor (Executor-class)|''Aggressor'']] and five more ''Imperial''-class ships.<ref name="ReconReport">{{JournalCite|2|Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant}}</ref>

In spite of this massive defending presence, the Rogues returned to Corellia to [[Mission to Corellia (Rogue Squadron)|rescue]] [[Fyric Fel]] and [[Syal Antilles Fel|Wynssa Starflare]] from their kidnappers.<ref name="FamilyTies">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Family Ties]]''</ref>

[[5 ABY/Legends|In the year after Endor]], the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] liaison officer with CorSec, [[Kirtan Loor]], ordered CorSec to attack "Rebels" of the New Republic. Many CorSec officers would not cooperate, believing CorSec answered only to the Diktat and not to the Empire and was for fighting criminals rather than "Rebels." One such officer, Corran Horn, was targeted by Loor for assassination and fled the planet. He was soon followed by fellow officers [[Gil Bastra]] and [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella Wessiri]], as well as Iella's husband [[Diric Wessiri]], all of whom faked their own deaths. In the light of this lack of cooperation, the Diktat dissolved CorSec and replaced it with the pro-Imperial [[Public Safety Service]].

Grand Admiral [[Danetta Pitta]] had taken command of the Imperial forces at Corellia in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], largely by bribing the Diktat, although it is likely that both Pitta and Gallamby remained nominally loyal to Imperial Center. They were challenged by [[Josef Grunger]], who had seized control of ''Aggressor'' and possibly some other elements of the defending fleet and who was now aiming to claim the Imperial throne. As Grunger moved to seize control of Corellian space, he clashed with Pitta at the [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]], which left both Grand Admirals dead, ''Aggressor'' and Pitta's [[Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere|Torpedo Sphere]] destroyed and both fleets badly mauled.

Corellia was an Imperial fortress world as late as 6 ABY and was under Imperial control as late as the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> It is not clear how effective the Imperial military presence at Corellia was after Tralus, but, the New Republic was slow to take control and the Diktat remained in power as late as [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. It was probably only after this date that Gallamby withdrew to hiding in the [[Outlier systems]], with Thrackan Sal-Solo and other Imperial functionaries;

[[File:ISDs_over_Corellia_EotECR.png|thumb|left|200px|A pair of ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers in orbit around Corellia]]
Due to the many Corellian fighters serving in the Rebel military, Corellia had long been accorded a leading political role in the Alliance and now, with countless Corellian expatriates at large within New Republic-held territory, the planet was represented ''in absentia'' by [[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]] on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]. As an unhappy consequence, many Corellian expatriates loyal to the New Republic were forbidden from returning to their homeworld by the Diktat, so the [[Corellian Sanctuary]] was built on Coruscant to honor the war dead and provide a focus for the community.

===New Republic===
{{Quote|Now that the Corellian Incident has been resolved, perhaps this planet and its system can be opened to the galaxy for trade. It would be splendid to see the bright, cheerful colors of the marketplace like I once saw it on a visit so long ago. It would also be a shining achievement on the part of the New Republic.|Airen Cracken|<ref name="CTD" />}}
Around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Corellian Sector finally joined the New Republic. [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] was replaced by the New Republic-appointed [[Governor/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Micamberlecto]] of [[Froz]] to administrate Corellian Sector. The [[New Republic Medical Institute]] was established on Corellia.

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jaden Korr]] went on an [[Mission to Corellia (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|investigation mission]] after receiving reports of [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] activity in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. Upon receiving a distress call from a mag-lev train, Jaden and Kyle found out that the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] were behind the attempts to blow up the train. Korr eventually stopped the bomb and the train and Katarn destroyed mercenary cargo ships successfully, thus ending the Disciples of Ragnos presence there for the time being.<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

However, the New Republic government had little actual power and was unable to prevent the rise of the [[Human League]], led by [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]. Corellia and the sector as a whole, had taken an economic downturn because of its growing isolationism and anti-alien policies. Sal-Solo usurped power during the [[Corellian Crisis]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], murdering Micamberlecto and declaring himself Diktat. He was defeated and [[Marcha]] of [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] was made Governor-General.

[[File:BelaVistal.png|thumb|right|220px|Bela Vistal, a secluded town on Corellia]]
Sal-Solo tried again to restore Corellian independence and actually managed to get elected Governor-General after his attempt to control Centerpoint Station during the Battle of Fondor, which ended in disaster for a New Republic/[[Hapan]] task force at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. This resulted in Marcha's resignation.

The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eelysa]] maintained an eye on Sal-Solo's [[Centerpoint Party]] and escaped Corellia with the Solos in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] after being injured, only to return upon her recovery. A year later, Eelysa was killed by a [[voxyn]] on Corellia, although [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and his wife [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] managed to escape another voxyn.

A year after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], Sal-Solo traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]], in an effort to gain their help in expelling the New Republic, but was instead forced to lead the [[Peace Brigade]] and was impeached as Governor-General and kicked out of the Centerpoint Party. Corellia remained a loyal member of the New Republic and later the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

===Galactic Alliance===
{{Quote|To all appearances, Corellia is about to experience a—a pasting, I believe the term is.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Corellia_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Corellia with city-structures criss-crossing the surface]]
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], following the political unrest sparked by a disastrous Jedi [[Mission to Adumar|mission]] to uncover an illegal missile factory on [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], Corellia joined several other worlds in resisting the Galactic Alliance. Thrackan Sal-Solo also initiated an attempt to bring Centerpoint Station back online. In response the Galactic Alliance launched a [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|preemptive strike]] on and above the planet [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] in the Corellian system in an attempt to bring the rogue worlds to heel.<ref name="Betrayal" />

This only widened the divide between the Galactic Alliance and the rebellious worlds. Even worse, the furious Corellians launched a counterstrike, thus worsening the confrontation even further and turning it into a [[Second Galactic Civil War|full scale war]]. Corellia would be joined by [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], elements from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], Adumar and [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].<ref name="Betrayal" />

During the insurrection, the government of the Corellian system was led by a [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister]] and each of the five worlds had a [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]]. The systems' military was led by a [[Minister of War (Five Worlds)|Minister of War]] and answered to the Prime Minister. At the start of the uprising, [[Aidel Saxan]] was Prime Minister and [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] was the Head of State of Corellia. In the midst of chaos the Galactic Alliance made its first strike at Corellia, starting a full scale war.<ref name="Betrayal" /> While all of this was going on Thrackan Sal-Solo was [[Assassination of Thrackan Sal-Solo|assassinated by his cousin]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] with the help of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Mirta Gev]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />

During the war, the Corellian leadership planned on drawing the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] into the war on their side by assassinating its [[Queen Mother]], [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] and her child, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]. The result of their plan failed as the Queen Mother and her daughter survived and most of the Hapans allied with the Corellian Alliance were captured or killed during the [[Battle of Hapes (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Hapes]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

The Corellians later reactivated Centerpoint Station. [[Darth Caedus]], learning of this, led a task force to Corellia to capture it, but sabotage by the [[Jedi Coalition]] destroyed the station before Caedus could take control of it. When the war ended, although Corellia and the rest of the Confederation made peace, they did not rejoin the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. However, they did [[Unification Summit|resolve]] post-war disputes [[43 ABY|two years later]] by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] on the Alliance capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

By [[137 ABY]], Corellia was within the [[Core Worlds Security Zone]] and, by extension, space controlled by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Corellian/Legends}}
[[File:Coronet_by_night.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The capital city of Coronet by night]]
{{Quote|The planet was a wondrous place many proud people called home.|Lieutenant Andur Thorsim|<ref name="CTD" />}}
The people of Corellia were a mixture of Humans, Drall and Selonians;<ref name="CATCW" /> Corellia's Humans may have been transported to the planet by [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]],<ref name="TEA" /> while Drall were native to [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] and Selonians hailed from [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> In spite of the differing origins of the [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[New Republic Intelligence/Legends|New Republic Intelligence Service]] accepted that all three were native to Corellia.<ref name="CTD" /> The majority of Corellia's inhabitants lived on farms or in small towns on the world's three large continents.<ref name="CATCW" /> [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] was spoken on Corellia.<ref name="TEA" />

The population of Corellia ranged from 16.5 billion<ref name="CTD" /> to 3 billion; Humans comprised 60% of this number, while Selonian and Drall minorities each took up 20%.<ref name="TEA" /> The term "[[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]" usually neglected the presence of Selonians and Drall, instead referring specifically to Human natives of Corellia. Corellia's Humans viewed the Corellian system's [[Double Worlds]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] as a dumping ground for prisoners and undesirable beings.<ref name="CATCW" />

Individuals native to Corellia included Rebel Alliance and New Republic hero Crix Madine,<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the smuggler Han Solo, Senator Garm Bel Iblis, Bel Iblis's advisor [[Sena Leikvold Midanyl]], the mercenary [[Irenez (Human)|Irenez]],<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> Imperial commander [[Saz Tyrson]],<ref name="POC">{{WEGCite|story=The Art of Betrayal|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref> and [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]].<ref name="DB Faytonni">{{DB|character|lieutenantfaytonni|Faytonni, Lieutenant Dannl}}</ref>

==Locations==
{{Quote|It's a strange and wonderful place. Like nothing you've ever seen before. Nothing at all like Coruscant.|Han Solo, to his children|<ref name="AaC" />}}
[[File:CorelliaMoon.jpg|thumb|left|150px|One of Corellia's moons]]
Coronet, the capital city of Corellia<ref name="CTD" /> and the site of a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], was where most offworlders arrived. The headquarters of the Corellian Engineering Corporation, as well as those of CorSec and many trade guilds and unions, were located in Coronet, along with the Diktat's complex and the [[Corellian Stock Exchange]].<ref name="CATCW" /> The world was also the site of tourist attractions including amusement parks, museums<ref name="CTD" /> such as the [[Corellian Space Museum]] and several others devoted to the history of Corellians in space and the [[Gold Beaches/Legends|Gold Beaches]] on the coast between Coronet City and [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. A [[grav-train]] line connected Tyrena to the Gold Beaches and Tyrena, having its own spaceport, handled the majority of offworlders visiting the beaches.<ref name="CATCW" /> Altogether, Corellia boasted at least eight spaceports: one Imperial class, three Stellar and four Standard.<ref name="CTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorelliaMoons.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Corellia had a total of three moons, including Gus Talon and Gus Treta.]]
When developing Han Solo's background for licensees in [[1977]], [[George Lucas]] named the Corellian homeworld as Crell, describing it as a "grim", "gaseous" world. The cities of Crell were satellites floating in the gas clouds, while the natives of Crell were winged fliers with clawed hands. This description appears to be derived from the Imperial Capital in his earlier drafts (then called [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]), which was reused for [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|Episode V]].<ref name="Making of">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref>

In the [[Wikipedia:Polish language|Polish language]] Corellia is named '''Korelia''', as a matter of pronouncing issues. The same fact applies to [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] (named "Karyda" in some translations). Other planets starting on the letter 'C' however are named in their original form. Both 'C' and 'K' versions are used in the Polish [[Fanon|fan fiction]] and web boards, depending on the point of view on the original names and translations. In [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], Commander [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] pronounces "Corellian" as '''''K'rell'n'''''. In the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel Star Wars]] comics, Corellia was often referred to as '''Correlli'''.<ref name="Marvel 100">[[Star Wars (1977) 100|''Star Wars'' (1977) 100]]</ref>

Both ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' state that Corellia has no moons. However, ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' indicates that Corellia has three moons and later sources have established [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] and [[Gus Treta/Legends|Gus Treta]] as two of them.

In the canceled novel ''[[Alien Exodus]]'', Corellia is named after Antonia Corelli, the pilot of the 25th Century Earth spacecraft, displaced by a wormhole en route to Alpha Centauri, whose passengers and crew were the first Humans in the Galaxy.

Although it has long been established as being a predominantly Human world with Drall and Selonian populations, the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' depicts the planet as having a large [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] population, fully integrated with the Human one.
